title: Forced Picture Naming Task
description: EEG dataset recorded during a forced picture naming task in sixteen native French-speaking men aged 18 to 70. Participants named black-and-white line drawings from the Snodgrass & Vanderwart corpus, with each trial comprising a pre-stimulus baseline, a post-stimulus phase, and a naming phase. The preprocessed data were used to characterize spatiotemporal EEG dynamics with optical flow patterns.
methods_description: Sixteen right-handed native French-speaking participants named pictures shown on a screen. Each trial had a 2 s baseline, picture onset at 0 s, a 0-1.5 s post-stimulation phase, and a 1.5-3 s naming phase. Each subject completed 270 trials. Stimuli came from the Snodgrass & Vanderwart line drawing corpus. Data were preprocessed with a dedicated pipeline. Four initial subjects were excluded because of hardware failure.
